sets.title: Earnings Quality 案例
sets.vignette:
NovaDx is a contract research and manufacturing services company. In the most recent fiscal year, NovaDx reported revenue growth of 28%, well above the industry average of 9%. Selected financial data (in millions):

                          Prior Year    Current Year
Revenue                     1,150         1,472
Net income                    186           320
Cash flow from operations     201           176
Accounts receivable           196           388
Inventories                   142           151
Capitalized software costs     12            68

Management attributes the growth to a new distribution strategy: products are shipped to distributors on extended payment terms with a broad right of return, while revenue is recognized at shipment (gross). In the earnings release, management highlights "adjusted EBITDA," which excludes share-based compensation of 41 million. The audit committee raised no objections.

sets.title: ESG Integration 案例
sets.vignette: Analyst Li Wei is valuing Meridian Chemical, a bulk-chemical producer. Her base-case DCF uses long-term growth of 2.0% and WACC of 8.0%. A new carbon pricing regime, effective 2030, is expected to reduce Meridian's annual operating cash flows by roughly 4%. Approximately 30% of production capacity is located in coastal flood-prone zones. Meridian has published a decarbonization roadmap with capex commitments, and 40% of executive bonuses are tied to emissions targets. The company also issued a 5-year green bond at a yield 25 bp below its conventional bond of similar maturity, ring-fencing proceeds for emissions-reduction projects with annual reporting to investors. Li Wei notes that two sovereign wealth funds on the shareholder register have engaged management on board independence this year.

sets.title: Analyst Conflicts 分析师冲突案例
sets.vignette: David Okafor, CFA, is a senior sell-side analyst at Stellar Securities covering pharmaceutical companies. Stellar's investment banking division is lead underwriter for an upcoming IPO of Helix Pharma, and the banking team has asked Okafor to initiate coverage with a "constructive" rating. Helix invites Okafor to a two-day "research summit" at a resort, all expenses paid. At the summit, Helix's CFO mentions in a small group session that the FDA review of their lead drug has been completed and approval is expected to be announced next week — this has not been publicly disclosed. Okafor also subscribes to an expert network and interviews a former Helix sales director, who describes routine details of the company's distribution agreements that are not public but are widely understood within the industry. Okafor's preliminary report rates Helix "buy," and he discloses in a footnote that a colleague in his firm owns 200 shares of Helix.

sets.title: PM Conduct 组合经理行为案例
sets.vignette: Maria Santos is a portfolio manager at BrightWay Asset Management, overseeing the BW Growth Fund and several separate managed accounts. Santos receives an annual "consulting fee" of 30,000 from TekData Corp, a company she frequently recommends to clients, in exchange for quarterly briefings — she has disclosed this arrangement to BrightWay's compliance officer orally. At a client presentation, Santos shows performance of her "selected strategies," which includes only accounts that outperformed their benchmarks, and presents a model portfolio's backtested returns without labeling them as simulated. A subadvisor's trader, Lee, front-runs client orders with his personal account; Santos, who reviews Lee's trading reports monthly, has not acted on several obvious instances because "trading is not my department." Santos's brother-in-law asks her to manage his account; she executes his trades after the BW Growth Fund's orders each day and before notifying individual clients of her recommendation changes.

sets.title: Regression Diagnostics 回归诊断案例
sets.vignette:
An analyst regresses a stock's monthly excess returns on three factors using 60 months of data:

        Excess Return = 2.5 + 0.80·MKT − 0.30·SIZE + 1.20·EARN + ε
        (standard errors)        (0.20)   (0.15)   (1.00)

SST = 500, SSE = 320. EARN is a dummy equal to 1 in earnings-surprise months. A colleague fits a second model dropping EARN, obtaining SSE = 337 and adjusted R² of 0.331. The residual plot against fitted values shows a funnel shape widening to the right, and the Durbin-Watson statistic is 1.8. (Critical t ≈ 2.0 at 5%.)

sets.title: Forecasting & ML 预测与机器学习案例
sets.vignette: A fund builds forecasting tools. Project A models log(revenue) of a SaaS firm on a time trend over 40 quarters: ln(Rev) = 4.2 + 0.031·t, R² = 0.96; an ADF test on the log-revenue series fails to reject a unit root. Project B regresses the price levels of two trending crypto tokens on each other, obtaining R² = 0.91 and a t-statistic of 22; the residual Durbin-Watson is 0.4; both price series have unit roots, and an Engle-Granger test on the residuals also fails to reject a unit root. Project C uses 300 candidate variables to predict corporate bond defaults with only 9 years of annual data; the trained classifier achieves 98.5% accuracy on the training sample but 66% on out-of-sample data.

sets.title: Equity Valuation 权益估值案例
sets.vignette: An analyst values Chroma Foods, a stable packaged-food producer. The company just paid a dividend of 2.00 per share, with a payout ratio of 50% and return on equity of 12%. The stock's beta is 1.0, the risk-free rate is 3%, and the equity market risk premium is 5%. Earnings are expected to grow 12% annually for each of the next three years (payout held constant), then revert to a sustainable 6% thereafter. A comparable producer trades at a trailing P/E of 24, and the analyst notes Chroma's earnings contain no significant one-time items.

sets.title: Residual Income & Private Co 剩余收益与私企估值案例
sets.vignette: Stonebridge Ltd is an unlisted machinery maker. Reported net income is 9.0 million, which includes 1.2 million of one-time gain on an asset sale and reflects the founder's compensation of 2.6 million; comparable market-rate CEO pay is 1.0 million. The company also leases its plant from the founder's family at 1.5 million per year versus a market rate of 0.9 million. Book value of equity is 50 million, and the analyst estimates Stonebridge can sustain a return on book equity of 20% with a 100% payout going forward (no growth). The required return on equity is 11%. Comparable listed peers trade at a trailing P/E of 15; precedent change-of-control transactions averaged a P/E of 17.

sets.title: Term Structure 期限结构案例
sets.vignette: The following annual-pay par bonds trade at par: 1-year yield 3.0%, 2-year yield 4.0%. An analyst must value a 2-year, 6% annual-coupon bond (face 100). She initially discounts both coupons at the 2-year YTM of 4%. Her associate instead bootstraps the spot curve and notes the implied 1-year-forward rate one year from now.

sets.title: Credit Risk & CDS 信用风险案例
sets.vignette: A bank holds 20 million face value of bonds issued by Atlas Manufacturing (a CDMO supplier), trading near par. The bank's internal model estimates a 1-year PD of 2.0% with a 50% recovery rate. Atlas's 1-year CDS trades at 120 bp. The bank's credit officer proposes either buying CDS protection on the full position or selling the bonds; a junior analyst suggests the bonds are fairly priced because the expected loss is covered by the bonds' 150 bp yield spread over government benchmarks.

sets.title: Forwards & Options 远期与期权案例
sets.vignette: A treasury manager at a CDMO exporter must hedge USD receivables. Spot USD/CNY is 7.10; the 6-month CNY interest rate is 4% and the USD rate is 2% (annualized). Separately, the firm's pension sleeve holds an index currently at 4,000, and a dealer quotes a 1-year European call (strike 4,000) at 320 and the same-strike put at 280; the 1-year risk-free rate is 3%. The manager's intern proposes two trades: (1) buying USD/CNY 6-month forwards to hedge receivables, and (2) buying both the call and the put to profit from 'whatever direction the market moves'.

sets.title: REITs & Real Estate 房地产案例
sets.vignette: Harbor REIT owns 12 logistics warehouses. Reported net income is 96 million; depreciation and amortization total 142 million; the period includes a 22 million gain on the sale of one warehouse. Recurring maintenance capex runs 38 million per year, and straight-line rent adjustments add back 6 million. Shares outstanding: 200 million; current share price: 9.60. The portfolio's appraised value is 8.6 billion against 3.4 billion of debt. Comparable REITs trade at an average P/AFFO of 16x. A private equity rival offers to buy the whole portfolio at a 5% discount to appraised value, net of debt.

sets.title: FX & Growth 汇率与增长案例
sets.vignette: A manufacturer has EUR receivables of 10 million due in 12 months. Spot EUR/USD = 1.10; the 1-year EUR interest rate is 1.5% and the USD rate is 4.5%. A dealer quotes a 12-month forward at 1.06. The CFO is also reviewing the country's macro data: labor force growth 0.5%, labor productivity growth 0.8%, capital growth 5.0%, capital's output share 0.30, and last year's GDP growth of 2.9%.

sets.title: Risk & Active Management 风险与主动管理案例
sets.vignette: A fund holds a 500 million equity portfolio benchmarked to a broad index. Daily returns have a mean of 0.03% and a standard deviation of 1.1%. The risk team reports a 1-day 95% VaR of 8.9 million (parametric) and 10.4 million (historical simulation). The portfolio's tracking error to the benchmark is 3.0% annually, with factor (industry) deviations contributing 1.8 and stock-specific deviations contributing 2.4. The manager's self-reported information coefficient is 0.05, applied to roughly 250 independent stock decisions per year, while the realized information ratio has been 0.55 over three years. The fund's stated style is large-cap value, but a holdings-based style analysis shows substantial small-cap growth exposure.

questions.kp: Revenue Red Flags 收入红旗
questions.stem: Which feature of NovaDx's results most directly challenges the quality of its reported revenue?
opts: Revenue growth of 28% versus an industry average of 9%
Accounts receivable growing much faster than revenue, combined with extended payment terms and a broad right of return
The use of adjusted EBITDA excluding share-based compensation
Inventories growing broadly in line with revenue
questions.exp: 应收增速（196→388，+98%）远超收入增速（+28%）+ 放宽信用政策 + 大额退货权，是收入质量恶化的直接信号，典型的压货/提前确认模式。A 只说增长快，不直接证明质量问题；C 是盈利质量问题，不是收入质量问题；D 存货正常反而是好消息。

questions.kp: Accruals Ratio 应计比率计算
questions.stem: NovaDx's average net operating assets (NOA) for the year were 700 million, and its cash flow from investing was –90 million (primarily capital expenditures and the capitalized software). Using the cash-flow-based approach, the accruals ratio is closest to:
questions.exp: 现金流法 Accruals Ratio = (NI − CFO − CFI) ÷ Average NOA = (320 − 176 − (−90)) ÷ 700 = 234 ÷ 700 = 33.4%。公式是'减 CFI'，CFI 为负值所以相当于把投资流出加回来——应计包含经营性应计（NI−CFO）和投资性应计（−CFI 中的资本化等部分）。比率越高，利润中未变现部分越多，盈利质量越低。

questions.kp: Earnings Normalization 盈利正常化调整
questions.stem: Which of the following adjustments would an analyst most appropriately make when assessing NovaDx's underlying earnings quality? (Select all that apply)
opts: Reverse the capitalized software costs by treating the current-year capitalization as an expense
Exclude share-based compensation from expenses because it is a non-cash charge
Treat the receivables buildup as a reduction in revenue quality rather than sustainable growth
Accept management's adjusted EBITDA as the best measure of recurring earnings
questions.exp: A 对：资本化软件成本从 12→68 百万异常跳升，费用化还原才能看到真实利润。B 错：SBC 是真实经济成本（稀释股东），CFA 明确不应加回。C 对：应收堆积=收入含金量下降，应下调可持续性判断。D 错：管理层自定义指标需要分析师自行正常化，不可直接采信。

questions.kp: Reporting vs Earnings Quality 报告质量vs盈利质量
questions.stem: The audit committee raising no objections is best characterized as:
opts: Sufficient evidence of high reporting quality
Relevant but insufficient evidence; governance mechanisms and auditor incentives must also be assessed
Evidence that earnings quality is high
Irrelevant to the assessment of financial reporting quality
questions.exp: 治理机制（审计委员会、审计师独立性、股权激励压力）是评估报告质量的证据链之一，但单独一项不构成充分证据。C 张冠李戴：治理属于报告质量维度，与盈利质量无关。A' sufficient'是陷阱词，案例题见到 sufficient/always/never 要警惕。

questions.stem: In Li Wei's valuation of Meridian, the carbon pricing regime and coastal facility exposure are most appropriately classified as:
opts: Immaterial, because the carbon costs begin in 2030 and are not reflected in current financials
Material ESG factors, because they are expected to affect future cash flows and/or the discount rate
Governance factors rather than environmental factors
Relevant only for investors pursuing impact investing
questions.exp: 重大性的判据是'是否影响现金流或折现率'，与时间远近无关。碳定价直接削减现金流，洪水风险影响 WACC 与资产减值——都是 ESG 整合必须处理的重大因素。A 是典型错误选项；C 归类错误；D 混淆了 ESG 整合与影响力投资。

questions.kp: ESG Integration Methods 整合方法
questions.stem: Li Wei builds two valuation scenarios — moderate and aggressive carbon pricing — and reports a valuation range instead of a point estimate. This approach is best described as:
opts: Adjusting the discount rate for ESG risk
Scenario analysis, adjusting expected cash flows under alternative ESG outcomes
Negative screening applied to valuation
Greenwashing mitigation
questions.exp: 情景分析：对碳价设不同路径→各情景下现金流不同→估值取区间。A 动的是分母，本题动的是分子（不同情景的现金流）。C 负面清单是组合构建层面的筛选，与估值方法无关。

questions.stem: The 25 bp lower yield on Meridian's green bond relative to its conventional bond is best interpreted as:
opts: Evidence that green bonds always trade at lower yields than conventional bonds
A greenium, reflecting investor demand for the labeled green use of proceeds and reporting commitments
A signal that the green bond carries higher credit risk
A violation of ICMA Green Bond Principles
questions.exp: Greenium：绿债因投资者需求强而收益率更低。'always'（A）是陷阱词——绿溢价的存在与否取决于市场，并非定律。C 方向反了：收益率更低意味着风险定价更低不是更高。D 相反：公司按 ICMA 四要素（用途、评估流程、资金管理、报告）操作正是合规表现。

questions.kp: Responsible Investing Approaches 责任投资方式
questions.stem: Which of the following describe approaches demonstrated in the vignette? (Select all that apply)
opts: Engagement/stewardship, as practiced by the sovereign wealth funds
Thematic investing, via the green bond's emissions-reduction focus
Negative screening, because Meridian operates in chemicals
Impact investing, because the green bond finances emissions reductions
questions.exp: A 对：主权基金通过沟通推动董事会独立=积极所有权/尽责管理。B 错：绿债是公司融资行为，不是投资者的主题投资。C 错：负向筛选是投资者剔除行业的行为，文中没有任何投资者因此剔除 Meridian。D 错：绿债是普通债务投资，投资者首要目标仍是财务回报，不构成影响力投资（影响力投资要求可度量的社会/环境效益为首要目标）。

questions.stem: A bank reports interest income of 62 million, interest expense of 28 million, and average interest-earning assets of 1,200 million. Its net interest margin is closest to:
questions.exp: NIM = (62 − 28) ÷ 1,200 = 34/1,200 = 2.83%。净息差用平均生息资产作分母，不要错用总资产或总负债。

questions.stem: A property insurer reports a loss ratio of 71% and an expense ratio of 33%. The combined ratio and the most likely conclusion are:
opts: 104%; underwriting operations are unprofitable and the company relies on investment income
104%; the company is profitable on an underwriting basis
38%; underwriting is highly profitable
97.7%; underwriting margin is thin but positive
questions.exp: Combined Ratio = 71% + 33% = 104% > 100% → 承保亏损 4%，盈利只能靠投资收益支撑（财险公司常见模式，也解释了其利润波动性）。D 的 97.7% 是把 71/（71+33) 之类的错误算法。

questions.kp: I(B) Independence and Objectivity 独立与客观
questions.stem: The investment banking team's request that Okafor initiate coverage with a "constructive" rating most likely places Okafor at risk of violating:
opts: Standard I(B), because accepting the request itself creates a conflict that impairs independence and objectivity
Standard VI(A), because the banking relationship must be disclosed to clients
No standard, because a "constructive" rating is not explicitly a "buy"
Standard V(C), because the request was not documented in research records
questions.exp: 投行部施压定评级直接威胁研究的独立客观性，触及 I(B)——接到这种要求本身就是风险信号，照做并发表即违规。B 的披露义务（VI(A)）是次要问题，题目问的是『要求他怎么做』对 Okafor 的直接风险；C 玩文字游戏，constructive=buy 的委婉说法；D 条文错配，记录保存与此无关。

questions.stem: With respect to the two information sources at the research summit, Okafor may most appropriately use the:
opts: FDA information but not the distribution details, because FDA approval is the more market-relevant fact
Distribution details but not the FDA information, because the expert-network channel is a legitimate research source
Neither, because both were obtained through non-public channels
Both, because the summit was open to invited analysts
questions.exp: 判断顺序：先问重大性，不问来源。FDA 审批完成且下周公布=重大非公开信息，不可用（来源是否『合法渠道』不改变 MNPI 属性）。分销协议细节=非公开但非重大（行业普遍理解的常识层面），马赛克理论允许拼贴使用。A 把『市场相关性』当标准，方向恰好反了；C 和 D 都是用来源而非重大性来判断，都是命题人最爱的错误模板。

questions.kp: VI(A) Disclosure of Conflicts 利益冲突披露
questions.stem: Okafor's footnote disclosure that a colleague owns 200 shares of Helix is:
opts: Sufficient to comply with Standard VI(A)
Insufficient, because VI(A) requires disclosure of conflicts that might impair his own independence — most notably the underwriting relationship between Helix and his employer
Insufficient, because all Stellar employees' holdings must be disclosed
A violation, because analysts may never publish on companies where any employee holds shares
questions.exp: 披露要完整、显著、及时：同事持仓只是次要冲突，真正的重大冲突是『投行部正在承销 Helix IPO』——这才是影响评级独立性的核心，必须披露。A 的 sufficient 是陷阱词；C 过度扩大披露范围（不要求全体员工持仓）；D 极端化错误项（披露充分即可覆盖，不是禁止）。

questions.stem: Which of the following actions would allow Okafor to attend the summit without violating Standard I(B)? (Select all that apply)
opts: Declining the offer and instead reviewing Helix's public filings and hosting a follow-up call at Stellar's offices
Attending only sessions held at Helix's headquarters during normal business hours, paying his own travel and lodging
Attending the full resort program, disclosing the arrangement to his supervisor after returning
Attending and reimbursing Helix for the conference fee portion only, since accommodations are incidental
questions.exp: A 完全回避——最稳妥。B 商业地点+正常工作时段+自费=客观性不受实质影响，可接受。C 错在两点：豪华度假村全包差旅是典型影响客观的招待（小额象征性才可披露豁免），且事后披露不能事前补救。D 错：自费范围必须覆盖旅行住宿，『conference fee only』等于仍接受赞助。12 版 Handbook 明确：发行人付费的奢华差旅应当拒绝或自费商业标准差旅。

questions.kp: IV(B) Additional Compensation 额外报酬
questions.stem: Santos's consulting arrangement with TekData is:
opts: Acceptable, because she disclosed it to the compliance officer
A violation of Standard IV(B), because additional compensation arrangements require written consent from both the employer and the paying party
A violation of Standard VI(C), because referral fees must be disclosed to clients
Acceptable, because the briefings provide value to both parties
questions.exp: 额外报酬两大要件：双方（雇主+付款方）+ 书面同意。口头告知合规官≠雇主书面同意，也不构成付款方同意。VI(C) 介绍费要披露给客户——Santos 也没做——但题目问的是安排本身的定性，核心违反 IV(B)。A 的『已披露』忽略书面形式；D『有价值』不改变利益冲突属性——这道题的关键记忆点：口头同意永远是错误项。

questions.kp: III(D) Performance Presentation 业绩呈现
questions.stem: Santos's client presentation most likely violates Standard III(D) because:
opts: She presented returns of only the accounts that outperformed, and presented simulated returns without labeling
She included separate managed accounts alongside the BW Growth Fund
She presented returns net of fees without also showing gross returns
She failed to obtain GIPS verification for the BW Growth Fund
questions.exp: III(D) 三宗罪本题记了两个：cherry-picking（只报跑赢的组合，违反公平准确完整）+ 模拟业绩未标注。B 没错——不同账户可以合并展示；C 无此要求（净费口径是更保守的合规做法，并不要求双口径）；D 陷阱：GIPS 是自愿标准，未验证不违规，只有『宣称合规却不合规』才违规。GIPS/III(D) 的『自愿但说到做到』是每年必考分界线。

questions.kp: IV(C) Responsibilities of Supervisors 督导责任
questions.stem: Santos's inaction regarding Lee's front-running is best described as:
opts: Not a violation, because trading reports were reviewed monthly
Not a violation, because front-running is a trading desk matter outside her responsibilities
A violation of Standard IV(C), because supervisors who detect violations must initiate compliance procedures rather than ignore them
A violation of Standard III(B), because client orders were not treated fairly
questions.exp: IV(C) 的核心：主管『知道或应当知道』下属违规就有义务行动——定期看到报告=应当知道。『不是我的部门』正是 Handbook 点名的推诿话术。A 把『看过报告』当『履职』；B 把职责范围窄化；D 条文错配：Lee 的 front-running 损害的是客户利益，但 Santos 的不作为违反的是她对下属行为的督导责任（IV(C)），III(B) 不是针对主管不作为的条款。识别『谁违反了哪条』时，先分清行为主体：Lee 违反 VI(B)/受托责任，Santos 违反 IV(C)。

questions.kp: III(B) Fair Dealing + VI(B) Priority of Transactions
questions.stem: Regarding Santos's handling of her brother-in-law's account and client notifications, which statements are correct? (Select all that apply)
opts: Treating the brother-in-law's account as a client account for trading priority purposes is appropriate
Executing her brother-in-law's orders after the fund but before notifying individual clients violates both III(B) and VI(B)
Notifying clients of recommendation changes at different times is acceptable if all eventually receive the information
Her own personal account transactions should occur before family members' accounts
questions.exp: A 对：家庭成员账户视同客户账户，优先级在雇主和自己之前。B 对：荐股变更通知发完（含家人视同的客户）之前先给家人成交——既不公平对待客户（III(B)，信息必须同步传达）也违反交易次序（VI(B)，客户>雇主>自己）。C 错：『最终都会知道』不成立，公平要求同步传达，时间差本身就是违规。D 错：自己排最后，家人视同客户排在自己前面。

questions.stem: An adviser recommends a high-yield bond fund to a 70-year-old retired client who described her objectives as "capital preservation with steady income" and moderate risk tolerance. The fund's prospectus states it may invest up to 80% in CCC-rated bonds. The adviser did not update the client's IPS before the purchase. The adviser's conduct most likely violates:
opts: Standard III(C) only
Standard III(A) only
Both III(A) and III(C)
No standard, because the fund's risk is disclosed in its prospectus
questions.exp: 双违规：III(C)——没更新 IPS 就推荐、标的与『资本保全+中等风险』不匹配；III(A)——审慎义务要求推荐前确保适合，同一事实同时踩两条是 Ethics 题的常见正确项。D 是经典陷阱：披露风险≠免除适合性义务，『客户签过风险揭示书』从来不是免责理由。

questions.kp: VII(B) Reference to CFA Designation 头衔使用
questions.stem: Three statements appear in investment advisers' marketing materials. Which one complies with Standard VII(B)?
opts: "As a CFA Level II candidate, Zhang is uniquely qualified to manage your portfolio"
"Our team includes three CFA charterholders with an average of 10 years' experience"
"Having passed the CFA exams, Li is certified by CFA Institute as an expert analyst"
"Enroll now to become a CFA in just two years"
questions.exp: VII(B) 口诀：事实性陈述可以，夸大暗示不行。B 是纯事实（持证人数+年限）。A 错在『uniquely qualified』暗示 CFA 授予独家资格；C 错在 CFA Institute 不『认证专家』——charterholder 是会员状态不是能力认证；D 错在『CFA』不能当名词指代持证人/暗示速成。另外 D 还暗示了时间承诺。考点变体：考后讨论具体考题违反 VII(A) 而不是 VII(B)，别混。

questions.kp: I(A) Knowledge of the Law 知法守法
questions.stem: An analyst discovers that her firm's new structured product marketing materials understate fees in a way that violates local securities regulations. Local law is silent on whether employees must report such violations internally. The analyst's first action under Standard I(A) should be to:
opts: Publicly disclose the violation to the press to protect investors
Resign immediately to dissociate from the violation
Seek to dissociate from the activity and follow firm compliance procedures, escalating within the firm and to regulators if required
Do nothing further, because she was not involved in preparing the materials
questions.exp: I(A) 的处置阶梯：脱离（dissociate）→ 按合规程序内部升级 → 法律要求时上报监管。立即辞职（B）和公开曝光（A）都是过度反应型错误项——Standards 只要求 dissociate，不要求牺牲职业；D 是反应不足型。『只脱离不报告』是否够？关键看法律是否强制报告，题目说法律沉默，则内部合规程序即可。记住处置阶梯比记单点动作更重要。

questions.stem: The colleague's model without EARN is preferred over the full model primarily because:
opts: Its R² is higher than the full model's R²
Its adjusted R² (0.331) exceeds the full model's adjusted R² (0.326), since EARN's t-statistic is insignificant
Its SSE of 337 is lower than the full model's SSE of 320
Removing a dummy variable always improves a regression
questions.exp: 全模型：R²=1−320/500=0.36，Adj R²=1−0.64×59/56=0.326。EARN 的 t=1.2/1.0=1.2 不显著，剔除非显著变量使 Adj R² 从 0.326 升到 0.331——惩罚项减小的收益超过 SSE 微增的损失。A 方向错误：R² 必然下降（0.36→1−337/500=0.326）；C 算术反了（337>320）；D『always』是陷阱词。比较不同变量个数的模型只看 Adj R²。

questions.kp: t 检验与 F 检验分工
questions.stem: Regarding the significance of the full model, the analyst should conclude that:
opts: The model is insignificant because the dummy variable EARN is not statistically significant
The model is significant overall, because F = (180/3)/(320/56) ≈ 10.5, even though one individual coefficient is insignificant
The model is insignificant because t(MKT) = 4.0 exceeds t(SIZE) = −2.0
No conclusion is possible without the critical F value
questions.exp: F = MSR/MSE = [(500−320)/3]/[320/56] = 60/5.71 ≈ 10.5，远超临界值 → 模型整体显著。局部不显著（EARN）与整体显著可以同时成立——这正是 F 和 t 检验回答不同问题的意义。A 把个体检验结论推广到整体；C 比较两个 t 值没有意义；D 拖延型错误项，F≈10.5 在任何常规临界值下都显著。

questions.stem: Holding MKT and SIZE constant, the coefficient on EARN (1.20) most likely means that:
opts: Earnings-surprise months add 1.20% to the stock's return on average, all else equal
An earnings surprise causes the stock to rise by 1.20% in the following month
EARN explains 1.20% of the variance of returns
The return is 1.20 in earnings months regardless of MKT and SIZE
questions.exp: Dummy 系数的正确读法：其他变量不变时，EARN=1 的月份平均回报高出 1.20（单位与 y 一致，题为百分比收益）。B 把相关当因果（回归不识别因果）；C 把系数当方差解释率（那是 R² 的语言）；D 丢掉『其他变量不变』且『regardless』极端化。系数解释三要素：数值+单位+条件——缺一不可。

questions.stem: Based on the funnel-shaped residual plot and DW = 1.8, which diagnoses are correct? (Select all that apply)
opts: The funnel shape indicates heteroskedasticity, making the reported t-statistics unreliable
DW = 1.8 implies approximately no first-order serial correlation, so no correction is needed for autocorrelation
Heteroskedasticity biases the regression coefficients
The appropriate remedy for the heteroskedasticity is White-corrected (robust) standard errors
questions.exp: A 对：残差漏斗=异方差，后果是标准误失真、t/F 不可靠（系数仍无偏一致）。B 对：DW≈2(1−r)，DW=1.8 → r≈0.1，接近 0，无显著一阶自相关。C 错：异方差不伤系数、只伤推断——『伤系数还是伤标准误』是诊断题第一刀。D 对：异方差的标准修正就是 White 稳健标准误（或 GLS）。多选题的『全选看似合理项』模式：用 C 这种概念性错误做排除锚。

questions.kp: Log-linear Trend Model 增长率解读
questions.stem: In Project A, the coefficient 0.031 on the time trend indicates that the company's revenue has grown at an average rate closest to:
opts: 0.31% per quarter
3.1% per quarter
31% per quarter
3.1% per year
questions.exp: Log-linear 模型 ln(y)=b₀+b₁t 中，b₁×100 = 每期恒定百分比增长率 → 0.031×100 = 3.1%/季度。A 是小数点错位陷阱；C 是单位混淆；D 把季度当年度——季度 3.1% 复利年化约 13%，别顺手换算，题目问什么答什么。R²=0.96 在这里只是陪衬，且 log 变换后 R² 不可与线性模型直接比。

questions.stem: Project B's high R² and t-statistic are best described as:
opts: Evidence of a strong short-term trading signal
A spurious regression, because both series have unit roots and the residuals are also non-stationary (no cointegration)
A valid long-term hedge relationship
Evidence that at least one series is stationary
questions.exp: 双单位根序列回归 + 残差仍非平稳（EG 检验不拒绝单位根）→ 无协整 → 伪回归。DW=0.4 极低 + R²=0.91 是非平稳回归的指纹。正确流程：各测 ADF（均为 I(1)）→ EG 残差检验 → 不协整则回归无意义。A『short-term signal』从无意义的回归里变不出信号；C『valid hedge』需要协整支撑；D 与题给条件矛盾。Project A 同样 ADF 不拒绝——但 A 是单序列趋势建模（可用差分或趋势模型），不犯伪回归错误。

questions.stem: Project C's drop from 98.5% training accuracy to 66% out-of-sample is most directly explained by:
opts: High bias, which requires a more complex model
High variance (overfitting), which regularization such as LASSO is designed to mitigate
Heteroskedasticity in the candidate variables
An error in the test set labels
questions.exp: 训练 98.5% vs 样本外 66% = 教科书式过拟合（高方差）：300 个变量 vs 9 个年度观测，模型把噪声当规律。LASSO 的 L1 惩罚把不重要系数压零，天然适配这种『变量远超观测』的场景。A 方向反了——高偏差（欠拟合）的表现是训练测试误差双高；C 是回归假设问题，与分类器泛化无关；D 无依据脑补。

questions.kp: 集成方法选择 Bagging vs Boosting
questions.stem: To reduce Project C's variance problem while keeping the model structure tree-based, the most appropriate ensemble method is:
opts: Boosting, because it sequentially corrects classification errors
Bagging with random feature subsets (random forest), because averaging many low-correlation trees reduces variance
Stacking, because it combines heterogeneous model types
Adding a time trend to each decision tree
questions.exp: 药方要对症：问题是高方差 → bagging（并行自助抽样+投票）专门降方差；随机森林再加随机特征子集降低树间相关性，是标准答案。Boosting 主要降偏差、且可能加剧对噪声的敏感（此处不适用）；C stacking 是组合异质模型，与『tree-based 保持结构』矛盾；D 把回归概念生搬到分类树。记忆钩子：Bagging=并行降方差，Boosting=串行降偏差。

questions.stem: A regression's F-statistic is highly significant, yet none of the four individual slope coefficients is significant. The most likely explanation is:
opts: Heteroskedasticity in the residuals
Serial correlation in the residuals
Multicollinearity among the independent variables
A misspecified intercept
questions.exp: 『整体显著 + 个体全蔫』是多重共线性的招牌症状：变量间高度相关使系数标准误膨胀，t 检验假阴性增多，但联合信息仍让 F 显著。异方差/序列相关的招牌在残差图和 DW 上，不制造这种『F 与 t 背离』。D 与显著性模式无关。若题目再给一个 VIF=8，即可确诊。

questions.stem: An analyst finds that a regression's residuals have constant mean and variance, but large residuals tend to cluster in certain periods. An ARCH(1) test on squared residuals is significant. The most appropriate conclusion and action are:
opts: The model is misspecified; add more independent variables
Mean forecasts are still valid, but prediction intervals are understated; use a GARCH model to capture the time-varying variance
The coefficients are biased; apply generalized least squares
Serial correlation is present; use the Durbin-Watson statistic
questions.exp: ARCH 的考点层级：① 识别——大波动聚类 + 对残差平方的 ARCH 检验显著；② 后果——均值方程的预测和系数不受影响（无偏仍成立），但常数方差假设错了，置信/预测区间偏窄；③ 修正——GARCH 建模时变方差。A 把 ARCH 当模型设定错误；C 说『系数有偏』错（ARCH 伤的是区间不是点估计）；D 张冠李戴——ARCH 与自相关是不同问题。

questions.kp: Big Data 文本处理流程
questions.stem: A firm wants to classify analyst reports as positive or negative on a company. The correctly ordered text-processing pipeline is:
opts: Tokenization → cleansing (remove stop words, lemmatize) → normalize → feature extraction (bag of words / TF-IDF)
Feature extraction → tokenization → cleansing → normalize
Cleansing → feature extraction → tokenization → normalize
Normalize → feature extraction → cleansing → tokenization
questions.exp: 固定顺序题：先把句子切成词（tokenization），再清洗（去停用词、词形还原），然后标准化，最后才做向量化特征提取（词袋/TF-IDF，进阶用词嵌入）。顺序题的记忆锚：『没有词就没有词袋』——特征提取永远在最后。监管文件的 NLP 应用（如 SEC filing 情感打分）用的就是这条流水线。

questions.stem: Which of the following regression problems biases the coefficient estimates themselves (not merely the standard errors)?
opts: Heteroskedasticity
Positive serial correlation
Omitting a variable that is correlated with both the dependent variable and an included regressor
Multicollinearity among regressors
questions.exp: 四大经典问题里，只有遗漏相关变量（且与已含变量相关）让系数有偏且不一致——遗漏变量的影响被『塞进』相关变量的系数里。异方差、序列相关、多重共线性都只伤标准误，系数保持无偏（前两者还一致）。这道题是『伤系数 vs 伤标准误』框架的反向考法，记住唯一答案：遗漏变量/形式错误。

questions.stem: The company's sustainable growth rate and required return on equity are closest to:
questions.exp: g = 留存率 × ROE = (1−50%)×12% = 6%——可持续增长率由『留存多少』和『留存赚多少』共同决定，与短期 12% 的盈利增速预测是两回事。r = Rf + β×MRP = 3% + 1.0×5% = 8%。B 把盈利增速当 g；C 忘记风险溢价；D 双错。此题是后续所有估值问的地基，g 和 r 错了后面全崩。

questions.stem: If the analyst applies the Gordon Growth Model directly using the long-term sustainable growth rate, the estimated value per share is closest to:
questions.exp: GGM：V = D₁/(r−g) = 2.00×1.06/(0.08−0.06) = 2.12/0.02 = 106 元。注意分子是 D₁（下一期）不是 D₀；r−g = 2% 这个分母是全部敏感性所在——若 g 估成 7%，估值立刻变成 141，模型对 g 的假设极度敏感（GGM 的固有特征，也是它的考点）。

questions.kp: 两阶段 DDM 终值折现
questions.stem: Using the two-stage forecast (12% growth for three years, then 6%), the value per share is closest to:
Based on the long-term assumptions, Chroma's justified forward P/E is closest to:
opts: 取决于可比公司
questions.exp: Justified leading P/E = 派息率/(r−g) = 0.50/0.02 = 25 倍。这个『合理』乘数完全由基本面（派息率、增长、风险）推导，不需要可比公司——D 是概念性错误。C 的错误路径：2/0.02 或 0.5/0.01。把合理 25 倍与可比公司 trailing 24 倍对照：市场定价与基本面推导基本一致，这是乘数法与 DCF 交叉验证的标准姿势。

questions.stem: Stonebridge's normalized net income is closest to:
opts: 8.2 million
9.0 million
9.6 million
10.8 million
questions.exp: 正常化：900万 − 120万（一次性出售收益剔除）− 160万（老板超额薪酬 260−100）− 60万（关联租赁溢价 150−90）= 820万。方向口诀：『费用付多了→利润加回来；一次性收益→剔掉』。D 的方向全部搞反（把该剔的留下、把该加的再减）；B 是未调整报表数；C 只剔了出售收益。

questions.stem: Using the residual income model with zero growth (100% payout, ROE 20%), the estimated equity value is closest to:
opts: 50 million
91 million
95.5 million
109 million
questions.exp: 零增长 + 全派息 → BV 恒为 50 百万不变，每年 NI = 20%×50 = 10 百万。RI = NI − r×BV = 10 − 0.11×50 = 4.5 百万/年，永续。V = BV₀ + RI/r = 50 + 4.5/0.11 = 50 + 40.9 = 90.9 ≈ 91 百万。B 对。错点解剖：A 只给账面价值（忽略了 ROE>r 的超额盈利能力）；C 用 ROE 直接除以 r（10/0.11+50=140.9 或漏 BV）；D 错把 20%×50/0.11=90.9 当 RI 终值再加 BV=140.9。RI 模型的灵魂一步：减去股权成本的机会成本——公司赚钱不等于为股东创造价值。

questions.kp: 先例交易 vs 可比公司乘数
questions.stem: For valuing a 100% controlling stake in Stonebridge, the most appropriate multiple and resulting value are:
opts: Comparable company P/E of 15; 123 million
Precedent transaction P/E of 17; 139 million
Comparable company P/E of 15; 139 million
Precedent transaction P/E of 17; 147 million
questions.exp: 控制权收购 → 先例交易乘数（17 倍，含控制权溢价与协同），乘以正常化盈利 8.2 百万 = 139.4 百万。A/C 用错了乘数——可比公司乘数对应少数股权定价基准，用于控制权交易会低估；D 用了未正常化的 900 万×17=153... 题设 147 来自 8.6×17 之类的中间错误。一句话记忆：『买控制权看先例交易（含溢价），买少数股权看可比公司（要打折）』。

questions.stem: If the analyst instead values a 30% minority stake using the comparable-company multiple, with DLOC = 15% and DLOM = 20%, which statements are correct? (Select all that apply)
opts: The pre-discount value of the stake is 36.9 million
The two discounts should be added: total 35%
The discounted value is approximately 25.1 million
DLOM would be smaller if the comparable peers were highly liquid
questions.exp: A 对：15×8.2×30% = 36.9 百万。C 对：36.9×(1−0.15)×(1−0.20) = 36.9×0.68 = 25.1 百万——两个折价相乘不相加，B 错。D 错方向：DLOM 衡量『本资产』相对于上市流通资产的流动性缺失，与可比公司自身流动性无关；若 Stonebridge 分红政策稳定、有出售协议等『准流动性』安排，DLOM 才会变小。错选 D 是把 DLOM 与相关系数搞混的典型。

questions.stem: An analyst estimates a firm's enterprise value at 2,400 million based on its operating assets. The market value of debt is 900 million, cash and equivalents are 200 million, and the firm holds a 30% associate stake with an estimated market value of 400 million. The equity value is closest to:
opts: 1,300 million
1,500 million
1,700 million
2,100 million
questions.exp: 股权价值 = EV − 债务市值 + 现金 + 非经营资产（联营股权按市场价值）= 2400 − 900 + 200 + 400 = 2100 百万。三个易错点：①只减债务忘加现金（得 1500）；②联营资产按账面 150 而非市场 400 计（得 1850，介于选项之间）；③EV 是否已含联营——本题明确 EV 基于经营资产，故联营整体加入；若题目说 EV 已按账面含联营，则应做『换出账面、换入市值』的调整（2400−150+400）再桥接。读题时先确认 EV 口径，是这类题的唯一难点。

questions.stem: A company has ROE of 18%, a required return on equity of 12%, and is expected to grow at 5% indefinitely. Its justified P/B ratio is closest to:
questions.exp: Justified P/B = (ROE−g)/(r−g) = (0.18−0.05)/(0.12−0.05) = 0.13/0.07 = 1.86。推导链条：P/B = 1 + (ROE−r)/(r−g)（永续零增长的变形）→ 本题为正增长版本。A 是『ROE=r 只配平价』的干扰；C 用 (ROE−g)/r；D 用 ROE/(r−g)。记住结论形态：ROE 每高于 r 一分，P/B 溢价放大——这是成长股估值的量化直觉。

questions.stem: When comparing two companies using EV/EBITDA, which adjustment is most appropriate before computing the ratio?
opts: Convert EBITDA to EBIT because interest is a financing cost
Capitalize operating leases and include the lease liability in EV, restating rent expense into depreciation and interest
Add back share-based compensation for both companies
Use book value of debt for both companies
questions.exp: 跨公司可比的前提是口径一致：若一家公司资本化租赁而另一家费用化，EBITDA 与 EV 都不可比——把经营性租赁资本化（负债进 EV、租金拆成折旧+利息）是标准调整。A 错：EV/EBITDA 的意义恰在于剔除资本结构（利息）差异；C 错：SBC 是真实经济成本，加回会扭曲（除非公司间政策差异极大且要另行分析）；D 错：EV 里的债务用市值。乘数法的灵魂是『分子分母同口径』，每道题都先问这一句。

questions.stem: Stock A trades at a forward P/E of 18 with expected earnings growth of 12%. Stock B trades at a forward P/E of 24 with expected growth of 20%. The PEG ratios and the most reasonable inference are:
opts: A: 1.5, B: 1.2; B is relatively cheaper per unit of growth
A: 1.2, B: 1.5; A is relatively cheaper
A: 1.5, B: 1.2; both are overvalued
PEG cannot be computed on forward earnings
questions.exp: PEG = P/E ÷ (g×100)：A = 18/12 = 1.5；B = 24/20 = 1.2。PEG 低 = 每单位增长付出的价格少 → B 相对便宜。PEG<1 传统上视为低估，但跨公司比较用相对值即可。C 多走了一步：PEG 高低不直接判『高估』（无风险与派息率调整）。D 错：forward PEG 完全可用且更常用。PEG 的两大缺陷（忽略风险、忽略派息率）决定它只能做初筛。

questions.stem: The 2-year spot rate implied by the par yields is closest to:
questions.exp: 平价 2 年期债：100 = 4/1.03 + 104/(1+s₂)² → 104/(1+s₂)² = 96.1165 → (1+s₂)² = 1.08201 → s₂ = 4.019%。平价收益率 4% 是『各期限即期利率的某种平均』，当曲线向上倾斜时，即期利率高于同期限平价收益率（尾部远期利率更高把均值拉高）。C 是把近似 2×4−3=5 当成即期的典型错误；D 是远期利率的干扰值。

questions.stem: The implied 1-year rate, one year forward (f₁,₂), is closest to:
questions.exp: f₁,₂ = (1+s₂)²/(1+s₁) − 1 = 1.081997/1.03 − 1 ≈ 5.05%，最接近 5.03%。快速近似法 f ≈ 2s₂−s₁ = 2×4.02−3 = 5.04%（『远期≈边际利率』的线性近似），选项按近似口径设计。记住排序：向上倾斜曲线中 f > s₂ > y₂——远期利率最高，它揭示边际定价；本题三个数 3% < 4.02% < 5.05% 依次递增。

questions.kp: 即期利率估值 vs YTM
questions.stem: The correct arbitrage-free value of the 6% coupon bond is closest to:
questions.exp: 用即期利率逐期折现：6/1.03 + 106/1.081997 = 5.8252 + 97.9667 = 103.79。若误用 YTM=4%：6/1.04 + 106/1.04² = 5.7692+98.0037=103.77——两者在本题接近，因为曲线平缓；但『正确方法』只能用即期利率：不同期限的现金流有不同的机会成本。A/B 是折现率用错期限或票面错算的产物。判断题眼：题目给了多个期限的收益率 → 必须 bootstrap，这是出题信号。

questions.stem: Curve shapes and strategy: the associate recommends buying a 3-year bond and selling it after 1 year under an unchanged, upward-sloping curve. This strategy is best described as:
opts: Riding the yield curve, profiting as the bond's maturity rolls down toward lower yields
An arbitrage, because the forward rate guarantees the selling price
A barbell strategy
Immunization against interest rate risk
questions.exp: 骑乘策略三要素：①曲线向上倾斜 ②买入期限长于持有期 ③假设曲线形态不变。持有 1 年后债券剩余期限从 3 年变 2 年，市场要求的收益率沿曲线下滑 → 价格上升，赚价差+票息。B 错：远期利率是『锁定利率』不是『保证价格』，且这不是无套利（承担了曲线变动风险）；C 杠铃是组合结构概念；D 免疫是负债匹配策略，方向相反（骑乘是主动承担久期风险博收益）。

questions.stem: The position's expected loss over the next year is closest to:
questions.exp: EL = EAD × PD × LGD = 20,000,000 × 2.0% × (1−50%) = 200,000。三步缺一不可：敞口 2000 万 × 违约概率 2% = 违约情形下的损失敞口 40 万；再乘损失率 50%（回收率 40%... 本题回收率 50%，LGD=50%）= 20 万。C=400,000 是忘了乘 LGD（默认全损）的典型错法；A 数量级错误；D 是把敞口当损失。EL 是『定价内』损失——已体现在债券利差中，这是 c1503 的概念基础。

questions.kp: CDS 隐含 PD 与定价比较
questions.stem: The risk-neutral PD implied by the CDS spread (using PD ≈ spread/LGD) is closest to:
questions.exp: PD* ≈ 120bp / 50% = 2.4%。市场隐含的违约概率（2.4%）高于银行内部估计（2.0%）——市场比银行更悲观。含义：①债券的 150bp 利差相对其风险可能偏薄（债券相对贵）；②继续持有裸敞口 = 承担市场已定价的恶化。A 忘了除 LGD；B 直接采信内部数；D 把利差 240... 120/0.3 之类的错算。这题展示『CDS 是市场实时 PD 计』的实用价值——您做供应商信用管理时可直接借用这个交叉验证思路。

questions.kp: Expected Loss 与价差的关系
questions.stem: The junior analyst's claim that the 150 bp spread 'covers' the expected loss is most accurately assessed as:
opts: Correct, because expected loss = spread × EAD over one year
Incorrect reasoning: expected loss is already priced into the bond's market value; the spread compensates for it and must also cover unexpected loss, liquidity, and risk premium
Correct, provided the recovery rate assumption holds
Incorrect only because the bank should use the CDS spread of 120 bp instead
questions.exp: 逻辑拆解：EL 是『平均而言』的损失，任何高于无风险的信用利差在均衡中都必须补偿 EL——所以『EL 被覆盖』是同义反复（价格里已扣）。投资者真正承担的是 UL（非预期损失）+ 流动性溢价 + 风险厌恶溢价，150bp 要对标的是这些 + 市场隐含 PD（2.4%）而非内部 PD。A 的等式把『定价补偿』与『会计损失』混为一谈；C 回收率只影响 EL 数值，不改变逻辑；D 换数字不换逻辑。这是信用风险管理的概念分水岭题。

questions.stem: If the bank buys CDS protection on the full 20 million position at 120 bp, its most likely motivation and the trade's structure are:
opts: To eliminate default risk entirely at a cost of 240,000 per year
To hedge credit exposure: pay 120 bp per year for the right to deliver bonds worth par against the 20 million notional in a default
To profit when Atlas's credit improves
To create a negative basis trade
questions.exp: CDS 结构：买方付保费（120bp×2000万=24万/年），违约时按面值交付债券获得 2000 万（赔付=面值−回收值）。风险对冲是标准动机。A 的『彻底消除』过头：有交易对手风险（CDS 卖方自己违约）与 basis 风险；C 方向反了——买 CDS 是做空信用，信用改善时保费白付；D 负 basis 交易是『买债券+买CDS』的组合套利称谓，本题只有单边买保护。注意 150bp 债券利差 vs 120bp CDS 的负 basis（−30bp）：同时持有债券+保护每年净收 30bp——这是下一层套利讨论，但需考虑资金成本与曲线错配。

questions.stem: A convertible bond (face 1,000) has a conversion price of 40 and the underlying stock trades at 46. The straight value of an identical option-free bond is 950. The bond trades at 1,150. Its conversion value and the minimum value floor are, respectively:
questions.exp: 转换比率 = 1000/40 = 25 股；转换价值 = 25×46 = 1,150。下限 = max(纯债价值, 转换价值) = max(950, 1150) = 1,150——股价高于转股价时，『债底』让位于『股底』，转债价格不低于转换价值（否则直接转股套利）。A 把面值当转换价值；B 正确给出转换价值但下限取错（下限不是市价，是两个底价中的高者）；D 面值无关。当下限=转换价值时，转债表现像股票（Delta≈1）；下限=纯债价值时表现像债——『下限取大』规则自动刻画这种切换。

questions.kp: Callable 有效久期与负凸性
questions.stem: As yields fall toward a callable bond's strike rate, the bond's effective duration will most likely:
opts: Increase, because price becomes more sensitive to rates
Decrease, because the call option caps price appreciation and the price-yield curve flattens
Remain equal to its modified duration
Become negative
questions.exp: 利率下行逼近赎回价 → 赎回风险上升 → 价格涨幅被『削平』（负凸性区）→ 价格对利率变化不敏感 → 有效久期缩短。这是含权债与普通债的本质区别：普通债利率下行时久期基本稳定（略升），callable 债反而收缩。A 是普通债的直觉，用在 callable 上即错；C 错：modified duration 不捕捉期权效应，必须用二叉树重估的有效久期；D 方向过度——价格不会随利率下降而下降。配对的 putable 债结论相反：利率上升时久期缩短（回售保护生效）。

questions.stem: A credit model that estimates default probability from observable market variables such as bond spreads and rating transition matrices, without modeling the economic causes of default, is best described as a:
opts: Structural model
Reduced-form model
Merton model
Hazard model with endogenous default
questions.exp: Reduced-form（简约式）：把违约当作『外生的随机事件』，直接用市场数据校准违约强度 λ（hazard rate），不关心违约背后的经济机制。Structural（含 Merton）从公司资产价值出发建模违约边界——理论优雅但资产价值不可直接观测。D 是文字干扰项（hazard rate 属于 reduced-form 的工具）。选择题眼：『market spreads / observable data / no need to model assets』→ reduced-form。

questions.stem: An investor notices a company's CDS trading at 200 bp while its comparable bonds trade at a Z-spread of 160 bp. The most likely interpretation and trade are:
opts: Positive basis of 40 bp; the bond is relatively cheap — buy the bond and buy CDS protection to lock in the differential
Negative basis of 40 bp; buy the bond and sell CDS protection
Positive basis; the market expects imminent default
The basis must be zero in equilibrium, so the quotes must be erroneous
questions.exp: Basis = CDS − bond spread = 200 − 160 = +40bp（正基差）。含义：同一信用的两个市场定价不一致——债券相对便宜（要求的利差低）或 CDS 相对贵（保护需求强）。套利结构：买债券（收 160bp）+ 买 CDS 保护（付 200bp）→ 每净付 40bp，锁定无风险化头寸（若平价债券近似），赌的是基差收敛。B 把符号搞反（这是负基差交易的结构：CDS 便宜时买保护卖债券方向才对）；C 过度解读——基差反映的是相对供需/融资条件，不预示违约；D 无套利约束的是『同一工具同一价格』，不同工具间的基差可以长期存在（有限套利）。

questions.stem: The fair 6-month USD/CNY forward rate is closest to:
questions.exp: CIRP：F = S×(1+r_本×t)/(1+r_外×t) = 7.10×(1+0.04×0.5)/(1+0.02×0.5) = 7.10×1.02/1.01 = 7.1703 ≈ 7.17。方向验证：人民币利率高 → 人民币远期贴水 → USD/CNY 远期价高于即期（美元升水）——数值与口诀一致。B=7.07 是利差方向搞反的产物（1.01/1.02）。实务含义：出口企业按 7.17 锁定优于即期 7.10，高息货币的远期升水对收汇方是『额外收益』。报价方向题先统一标价法（本题为 1 美元=多少人民币，即间接标价下的 USD/CNY），再代公式。

questions.stem: One month after signing a 6-month forward at the fair rate, the spot rate moves to 7.25 (rates unchanged, 5 months remaining). The value of the long forward position per USD is closest to:
opts: Zero, because the contract was signed at fair value
questions.exp: 先算新远期价：F_t = 7.25×(1.02/1.01) = 7.3215；再算多头价值（按剩余 5 个月折现）：V = (F_t − K)×e^(−r×t) = (7.3215−7.1703)×e^(−0.04×5/12) = 0.1512×0.9835 = 0.1487 ≈ 0.149。C=0.151 是忘了折现的错误值（签约价与新远期价差直接当价值）；D 是本单元最经典的时态错误——『签约时价值为零』≠『存续期价值为零』。方向直觉：USD 升值 → 收美元的企业远期多头赚钱，与套保目的相符。

questions.stem: For the options on the 4,000 index, the put-call parity implies the put should trade at approximately:
questions.exp: 平价：p = c − S₀ + Xe^(−rT) = 320 − 4,000 + 4,000×0.97045 = 320 − 4,000 + 3,881.8 = 201.8 元。市价 280 显著高于平价 → 看跌被高估。A 的算式虽数值巧合接近，但结构错误（乱折现标的价而非执行价）；B、D 是直接抄市价的偷懒项。套利动作（c1704 承接）：卖看跌 + 买看涨 + 卖空指数 + 存入 PV(X)，期初锁定无风险收益。

questions.stem: Regarding the intern's proposal (2) — buying both the call and the put — and the parity violation, which statements are correct? (Select all that apply)
opts: Buying both options is a long straddle, profitable only if the index moves substantially in either direction
The long straddle is delta-neutral at inception
The parity violation allows a riskless profit: sell the put, buy the call, short the index, and invest PV(X)
The straddle would profit even if the index stays at 4,000 at expiry
questions.exp: A 对：买入跨式（long straddle）= 赌大波动，盈亏平衡点 = X ± (c+p)，指数在 4,000±600 内到期都是亏损——不是『无论涨跌都赚』。B 对：平价期权 Delta 看涨 +0.5、看跌 −0.5，组合 Delta≈0（标的微小变动不影响组合价值，但 Gamma 为正——波动才是组合的朋友）。C 对：平价套利四件套（卖高估的 p、买 c、做空标的、存入 PV(X)），期初现金流锁定。D 错：指数不动则两份期权都到期作废，亏损全部权利金 600 点——Theta 是买方敌人。这题把『方向策略（straddle）』与『套利策略（parity）』放在同一案例对比，正是 Item Set 的出题节奏。

questions.stem: Harbor REIT's funds from operations (FFO) for the period is closest to:
opts: 96 million
216 million
238 million
260 million
questions.exp: FFO = 净利润 + 折旧摊销 − 出售物业损益 = 96 + 142 − 22 = 216 百万。两个调整方向相反：折旧加回（非现金且对 REIT 经济意义有限）、出售收益剔除（非经常）。C=238 是忘了减出售收益（只加回折旧）；D=260 是连折旧加出售收益都加回（方向全错）；A 是未调整的净利润。FFO 是 REITs 的『房地产版净利润』，考试必考调整链。

questions.stem: AFFO per share and Harbor's implied P/AFFO at the current price are closest to:
questions.exp: AFFO = FFO − 经常性资本开支 + straight-lining 调整 = 216 − 38 + 6 = 184 百万；每股 = 184/200 = 0.92 元。P/AFFO = 9.60/0.92 = 10.4 倍。A 是扣掉资本开支但忘了加回 straight-lining（0.92−... 0.70=(216−38−6)/200 的调整混乱版）；C 是没扣资本开支（216+6−38=184... C=1.08=(216+6×2)/200 之类）；D 直接 FFO/股本。与可比公司 16 倍对比：Harbor 显著便宜——下一步必须问『为什么便宜』（区位？租户集中？利率敏感？），便宜本身不构成买入理由。

questions.stem: The REIT's net asset value per share and its trading status are:
opts: NAV 26.0; trading at a premium
NAV 26.0; trading at a discount of about 63%
NAV 48.0; trading at a deep discount
NAV 12.0; trading at a discount of 20%
questions.exp: NAV = 86 亿 − 34 亿 = 52 亿；每股 NAV = 5200/200 = 26 元。现价 9.60 → P/NAV = 0.369，即折价约 63%。这看起来极端——但正是本题的设计意图：巨额折价（或评估值虚高）提示必须审视①评估值是否滞后于市场重估（利率上行期 cap rate 没跟上）②是否存在治理/集中度问题。A 方向判断反了；C 的 NAV 算错（8.6−3.4=5.2 亿 vs 52 亿的数量级混淆）；D 的 NAV 用了错误口径。实务对应：港股 REITs 与内地物流资产包的真实折价案例。

questions.kp: 私募收购报价 vs 公开市场估值
questions.stem: The rival's all-cash offer values the equity at 4.94 billion. The most accurate interpretation is:
opts: The public market is pricing the assets fairly, and the REIT should reject the offer
The offer validates that appraisal values lag market-clearing levels, and the board should weigh liquidity premium vs. control value
The offer must be rejected because 5% is below appraised value
The offer implies P/AFFO of 26.8x, far above comparables, so it is overpriced
questions.exp: 报价隐含股权价值 49.4 亿 vs 当前市值 19.2 亿（9.6×2 亿股）——溢价 157%，远超 5% 的字面含义（5% 是对评估净值 52 亿的折让，但市场早已把价格打到 0.37 倍 NAV）。解读三要点：①私有市场报价包含控制权+整售流动性溢价，与零散股交易价不可直接比；②评估值滞后是 REITs 折价的标准解释之一；③董事会决策要看：报价的确定性、税负、再投资去向。A 用『公允』一笔带过巨额差价；C 只看 5% 折让的数字表面；D 用错误口径（49.4/1.84=26.8）下结论——对整售控制权交易，AFFO 乘数不是合适标尺。

questions.stem: A commodity index's front-month futures trade at a 4% discount to spot (backwardation). For a long futures investor, the roll yield is most likely:
opts: Negative, because the investor must sell low and buy high when rolling
Positive, because the investor sells the appreciated expiring contract and buys the cheaper next-month contract
Zero, because futures converge to spot at expiration
Unknowable without the path of spot prices
questions.exp: Backwardation（期货贴水）：展期时卖出即将到期（已升值收敛）的合约、买入更便宜的新合约 → 正展期收益。A 描述的是 contango 的情形，方向张冠李戴；C 的『收敛』恰恰保证了 roll 的存在——收敛过程本身就是收益来源；D 拖延型错误项：roll yield 由曲线形态决定，与现货路径无关（现货影响的是价格收益那一层）。记忆钩子：backwardation = 『back』到期合约滚回更便宜的远月 = 多头开心。

questions.stem: In computing net operating income (NOI) for direct capitalization, an analyst should exclude:
opts: Property management fees and utilities
Depreciation, interest expense, and income taxes
Vacancy and collection losses
Landscaping and security costs
questions.exp: NOI = 有效毛收入 − 运营费用，三大剔除：折旧（非现金）、利息（价值先于资本结构）、所得税（unlevered 口径）。其余都是运营费用必须扣除。这个口径与 FCFF 的『企业自由现金流』精神一致——估值站在资产本身，不站融资方式。考试给『净利润』倒推 NOI 时，把这三项加回即可；反过来给 EBITDA 口径时，注意 EBITDA 含管理费前的一些差异项。

questions.stem: A hedge fund starts the year at NAV 200, ends at 250 (before fees). The annual management fee is 2% of year-end NAV and the incentive fee is 20% of the profit above the high-water mark (prior high: 210). Total fees for the year are closest to:
questions.exp: 两步：①管理费 = 250×2% = 5.0；②业绩报酬基数 = 期末净值 − 高水位 = 250 − 210 = 40（高水位 210 高于期初 200，因为前几年尚未完全回本），业绩报酬 = 40×20% = 8.0。总费用 = 5 + 8 = 13.0，选 D。本题核心考点：业绩报酬基数用 max(高水位, 期初净值)，不是期初净值——若误用 200 作基数：(250−200)×20% = 10，总 15（无此选项，但命题人常把 10 单独放出来当陷阱：C=10 就是这个错法的业绩报酬部分）。高水位的保护作用：前几年亏损没回本的部分，今年赚的先填坑，坑没填完不提业绩报酬。投资者净所得 = 250 − 13 = 237，净收益 18.5%（对比毛收益 25%）——2&20 的 drag 一目了然。

questions.stem: Compared with REITs prices, appraisal-based private real estate indices most likely exhibit:
opts: Higher volatility and higher correlation with equities
Lower volatility, lower apparent correlation with equities, and overstated Sharpe ratios
Identical statistical properties because they track the same assets
Higher volatility due to stale appraisals
questions.exp: 评估价平滑化的统计后果：波动被低估、与股票相关性被低估、夏普比率被高估——『又稳又赚』部分是幻觉。资产配置决策若基于未调整的私募 RE 指数，会系统性高配房地产（实际风险被低估）。A 全部方向相反；C 否认偏差的存在；D 把平滑说成放大。修正方法：对私募 RE 指数做『去平滑』（unsmoothing）处理，或用 REITs 价格做风险参照——这也是 Yale 模型等大学捐赠基金模型的标准动作。

questions.stem: The no-arbitrage 12-month EUR/USD forward rate is closest to:
questions.exp: EUR/USD=1.10 表示『1 欧元 = 1.10 美元』。推导法（永不犯错）：1 欧元投欧洲，1 年后 1.015 欧元，按远期 F 换成美元 = 1.015F；1 欧元即期换 1.10 美元投美国，1 年后 1.10×1.045 = 1.1495 美元。无套利要求两者相等：F = 1.1495/1.015 = 1.1325 ≈ 1.13。公式形式：F = S×(1+r_报价货币)/(1+r_基准货币)——分子是『1 单位基准即期换来的报价货币』的投资终值。方向验证：美元利率高 → 美元远期贴水 → 1 欧元远期换更多美元（1.13 > 1.10）✓，与『高息货币远期贴水』口诀一致。A=1.06 是利差方向搞反；B 是即期价；D 是半道折中。

questions.stem: Regarding the EUR receivable, the CFO should most likely:
opts: Sell the 10 million EUR forward at 1.06, locking in 10.6 million USD and eliminating the exposure
Delay hedging, because uncovered interest rate parity implies the euro will appreciate by the interest differential
Convert the receivable in the spot market now
Buy a 12-month EUR call option as a cheaper alternative that keeps all upside
questions.exp: 套保第一原则：头寸方向由业务决定，衍生品只负责消除风险——1000 万欧元应收是天然欧元多头，卖远期锁定 1060 万美元，『确定的 1060』优于『期望 1100 但可能 1000』。B 把 UIRP 当预测工具：UIRP 是『预期』不是『定律』（carry trade 长期存在就是反证），用它决策是把套保做成投机；C 不可行——应收账款尚未到期，没有现货可卖；D 的期权确实保留上行但要付权利金，『更便宜』未必成立，且题目问『最可能』的常规动作——远期是应收应付的标准工具（期权适合不确定金额的情景）。银行报价 1.06 低于无套利 1.13，CFO 的改进动作是多询几家比价，而非放弃套保。

questions.stem: The economy's total factor productivity (TFP) contribution to last year's growth is closest to:
questions.exp: 增长核算三步：①劳动增速 = 劳动力 0.5% + 生产率 0.8% = 1.3%；②要素贡献 = 0.30×5.0%（资本）+ 0.70×1.3%（劳动）= 1.50% + 0.91% = 2.41%；③TFP = GDP 增速 − 要素贡献 = 2.9% − 2.41% = 0.49% ≈ 0.5%。错项解剖：B=0.9 是劳动项忘了加生产率（0.70×0.5%=0.35，得 TFP=2.9−1.5−0.35=1.05... 对应 C=1.1 的算法）；D 是把资本贡献当 TFP。本题 TFP 仅 0.5% 是成熟经济体典型画像：增长主要靠要素投入，技术进步贡献微薄——这正是内生增长理论呼吁研发补贴的实证动机。

questions.kp: 提升潜在增速的政策杠杆
questions.stem: Which policy is most likely to raise the economy's potential growth rate, based on endogenous growth theory?
opts: A one-time increase in infrastructure investment
Permanent subsidies for R&D and stronger intellectual property protection
Temporary tax rebates to stimulate consumption
Raising the retirement age without any other change
questions.exp: 内生增长理论：知识/研发的外部性使 A（技术进步）的回报不递减 → 永久性的研发激励能永久抬高潜在增速。A 一次性基建只抬升 K 的水平（水平效应），在 Solow 框架里资本深化有报酬递减，长期增长仍回到 TFP 决定——『一次投入，永久效果』是内生增长论独有的承诺。C 是需求侧刺激，只影响实际 GDP 围绕潜在值的波动；D 提高劳动数量的增速，属于 (1−α)×L 的要素项，有贡献但新古典框架下同样受限于稳态。考点分辨：问『永久提高增长率』→ 找 A/技术；问『提高产出水平』→ 资本/劳动投入都可以。

questions.kp: 参数法 VaR 与正态偏差
questions.stem: The parametric 1-day 95% VaR stated by the risk team is based on a mean of 0.03% and a standard deviation of 1.1%. It is closest to:
opts: 8.0 million
8.9 million
9.1 million
10.4 million
questions.exp: 参数法：VaR = V×(zσ − μ) = 5亿×(1.645×1.1% − 0.03%) = 5亿×(1.8095%−0.03%) = 5亿×1.7795% = 8.90 百万。注意均值符号：μ−zσ = −1.78%，取绝对值。C=9.1 是忘了减均值的 1.645×1.1%=9.08；A 是用错 z 值（1.28 对应 90%）；D 是抄历史模拟值。两个 VaR 的差异（8.9 vs 10.4，历史法高 17%）说明收益率分布左尾厚于正态假设——这是『参数法低估尾部』的现场证据。

questions.stem: The reported tracking error of 3.0% is consistent with the factor and stock-specific contributions because:
opts: They add linearly: 1.8 + 2.4 = 4.2
They combine as variances: √(1.8² + 2.4²) = 3.0
They are equal at 1.5 each
The factor contribution dominates in all market conditions
questions.exp: TE 的正交分解：总 TE² = 因子贡献² + 特质贡献²（假设两者不相关）→ √(3.24+5.76) = √9 = 3.0 ✓。A 的线性相加是概念错误（波动率不可直接加，除非完全正相关 1.0）；C 无中生有；D『所有市场环境』是陷阱词。分解的业务含义：因子偏离 1.8 是有『赌注』的部分（行业观点），特质 2.4 是选股噪声——该经理的 TE 一半以上来自可被行业 ETF 对冲的因子风险，纯 alpha 含量存疑。

questions.kp: 基本定律与 IC 诊断
questions.stem: According to the fundamental law (IR ≈ IC×√B), the manager's reported IC of 0.05 and 250 decisions imply an expected IR of approximately:
questions.exp: IR 上限 = 0.05×√250 = 0.05×15.81 = 0.79。实际 IR 只有 0.55 → 实现率 0.55/0.79 = 70%。缺口解释三选：①决策不独立（同行业股票相关性）②约束消耗（TC<1：TE 上限、行业中性要求）③IC 高估（回测口径乐观）。A=0.55 是实际值（题目问『imply』即理论上限）；C=1.25 是忘了开根号的 0.05×250；D 数量级错误。这个『理论上限 vs 实际』的缺口诊断（TC 估算 = 0.7）正是基本定律在尽调中的用法。

questions.kp: 风格漂移与 VaR 局限
questions.stem: Regarding the style analysis finding and the risk measures, which statements are correct? (Select all that apply)
opts: The fund exhibits style drift relative to its stated large-cap value mandate
A 95% VaR of 8.9 million means the expected loss beyond VaR is also 8.9 million
Expected shortfall (CVaR) would address VaR's failure to indicate the depth of tail losses
Style drift is acceptable as long as the fund outperforms its benchmark
questions.exp: A 对：持仓风格分析显示实质暴露偏离宣称的大盘价值 → 风格漂移（style drift）——投资者买到的不是招募说明书里的产品，属尽调红旗。B 错：VaR 只报分位点（95% 置信下的最大预期损失），『超过之后平均亏多少』是 ES/CVaR 回答的问题——混淆这两者是概念题的经典错误。C 对：ES = 超过 VaR 部分的平均损失，是 coherent risk measure，补上 VaR 的尾部信息缺口。D 错：风格漂移即使当期赚钱也违反授权——委托关系的根基是投资者为特定风格付费（费用、税负、组合搭配都基于此）。多选题用 B（概念混淆）和 D（受托逻辑）做排除锚。

questions.kp: Free Cash Flow Hypothesis 自由现金流假说
questions.stem: According to the free cash flow hypothesis (Jensen), a mature firm with large stable free cash flows and few growth opportunities should most likely:
opts: Retain all cash to maximize managerial discretion
Increase payouts, because committing to payouts reduces the free cash flow available for managerial overinvestment
Issue new debt and hold the proceeds as cash
Cut dividends to signal financial strength
questions.exp: Jensen 的自由现金流假说：管理层手中现金越多越容易乱投资（帝国建造），提高分红/回购把现金交还股东，压缩代理成本。这是'分红有益论'中基于代理成本的论证，与信号理论（C/D 的分红逻辑）区分记忆。

questions.stem: A company announces it will repurchase up to 2 million shares, inviting shareholders to tender shares within the range of 48 to 54 per share, and will determine the lowest price within that range that allows it to buy the desired quantity. This method is a:
opts: Fixed-price tender offer
Dutch auction tender offer
Open market repurchase
Direct negotiation repurchase
questions.exp: 荷兰式拍卖回购：给出价格区间，股东投标，按能买到目标数量的最低价格统一成交。固定价要约没有区间；公开市场回购是直接在二级市场买，无投标过程。
